title: Soft Dawn
summary:
On a recent morning in Downtown Toronto, three major still-rising towers capture some of early dawn's softest light bouncing off newly installed windows. From left to right, the United BLDG, 8 Elm, and Concord Sky rise under cranes into skies already locally dominated by the Residences of 488 University, Prime Condos, and Aura.

Soft colours on Downtown Toronto are a hallmark of dawn's earlies
